en.title: Grey Silence and the Remnants of Forsaken Words
en.premise: In a world where every memory is optimized into data and unnecessary emotions are purged as 'noise,' Ellis works as a cleaner for the Administration Bureau, spending her days discarding the remnants of people's lives. One day, amidst the waste, she discovers a physical 'old book' written on paper. It is a forbidden record etched with someone's 'pain'—a relic found only in the black markets where memories are bought and sold.

zh.title: 灰色的静寂与被遗弃之言的残滓
zh.premise: 这是一个所有记忆都被优化为数据，不必要的情绪被当作“噪音”删除的世界。主角艾莉丝作为管理局的清扫员，每日重复着销毁他人冗余记忆的工作。直到有一天，她在废弃物中发现了一本由实体纸张装订而成的“旧书”。那是刻有某人“痛苦”的禁忌记录，唯有在买卖记忆的黑市中才能寻得。
